In April 2026, we celebrated the commissioning of the 105 MW Pastoria Solar Project, the largest renewable energy project contracted by the California Department of Water Resources to date in its mission to fully decarbonize its operations by 2035.
The Pastoria Solar Project connects to the grid through the interconnection facilities at our highly efficient 750 MW natural gas-fired Pastoria facility.
